name: Yinson Holdings Berhad
summary: Yinson Holdings Berhad, an investment holding company, operates as a floating, production, storage, and offloading (FPSO) service provider in Malaysia, Ghana, Nigeria, Brazil, India, Angola, Peru, and intentionally. It operates through Offshore Production & Offshore Marine, Renewables, Green Technologies, and Other operations segments. It leases and sub-leases FPSO and offshore support vessels; builds, owns, and operates renewable generating assets; ship and asset management services.
